# `mise daemons ls`

- **用法：** `mise daemons ls [--json]`
- **别名：** `list`
- **效果：** 只读
- **源代码：** [`src/cli/daemons.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/daemons.rs)

[experimental] List project daemons

Shows each daemon's ID, status, and source without starting a supervisor or registering configuration.

## Flags
- **`--json`** — Output in JSON format, including ports, URLs, and data directories
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Examples

Include ports, URLs, and data directories

```
mise daemons ls --json
```
